Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Back in the day, ‘C-Link’ meant ‘Cybermodem Link,’ or a neural link that translates net data into usable images. Over 50 years later, and this ancient tech has been far surpassed by superior iterations of the same concept — Virtuality Optics, Neuroport Cyberdeck Ports, and so on. Thus, ‘C-Link’ now refers to something else entirely: Cervical Link.

Cervical Links are rear-cranial cable sockets that replace cervical nerves with high-speed wires and buffer blocks. This allows a ‘runner to stream absurd amounts of data per picosecond straight into their brain stem. Only the best (and mentally strong) code surfers have any hope in digital hell of using high grade C-Links at their full potential.

Neuralware. Borgware. Requires Neuroport Cyberdeck Port and 2 Neuralware Option Slots. Only one C-Link Socket may be installed at a time. While installed, the user gains the following benefits:

  • If the user’s current INT is higher than their Interface Rank, their Interface Rank is considered 1 higher while Jacked In, including inside of a Neuroport.
  • While Jacked In, the user gains a +2 bonus to TECH and INT based Skill Checks related to digital data and/or systems (decrypting files, understanding security, etc).
  • Once per day when the user Jacks In to a non-Neuroport Net Architecture, their first NET Action does not cost a Net Action.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
